market_context.summary: US retail e-commerce reached $347.3 billion (seasonally adjusted) in Q3 2026, 17.9% of total retail sales and 10.4% above Q3 2025 (US Census Bureau). The market is concentrated: EMARKETER forecasts Amazon at 39.7% of 2026 US e-commerce sales and Walmart.com above 10% for the first time, and Similarweb's October 2026 ranking puts amazon.com, walmart.com, ebay.com and temu.com at the top of the shopping category. Beauty is one of the most digitised categories: NielsenIQ data reported in March 2025 put online at 43% of US beauty sales (2024 data, dated), and NielsenIQ's April 2026 data rank TikTok Shop as the #4 US health-and-beauty retailer. For mass-market hair, skin and oral care the checklist brands were verified on Amazon, Target, CVS, Walgreens, Costco, Sam's Club and Instacart; beauty specialists split between Ulta (mass plus prestige) and Sephora (prestige). Quick delivery is consolidating: DoorDash agreed in October 2026 to acquire Instacart for about $17 billion.

key_facts.fact: US retail e-commerce sales were $347.3 billion in Q3 2026 (seasonally adjusted), 17.9% of total retail sales, up 10.4% from Q3 2025 and 1.6% from Q2 2026.

EMARKETER forecasts Amazon at 39.7% of US e-commerce sales in 2026, Walmart.com above 10% for the first time, and the top 18 retailers at 75.1% of US retail e-commerce sales (forecast; read from the search-result summary because the article page returned HTTP 403).
Similarweb's October 2026 ranking of US 'Ecommerce & Shopping' sites lists amazon.com, walmart.com, ebay.com, temu.com and etsy.com as the top five.

NielsenIQ data reported by Retail Brew: online reached 43% of the total US beauty market; beauty e-commerce sales rose 11.1% to $45.7 billion out of $107.5 billion. The data relate to 2024 and are dated (older than 18 months).
NielsenIQ data published 24 April 2026 rank TikTok Shop as the #4 US health and beauty retailer, with trailing-12-month category sales above $4.4 billion (+84% year on year).
Momentum Works and Tabcut estimate TikTok Shop US gross merchandise value at $11.8 billion in the first half of 2026, up 103% year on year; worldwide first-half GMV was an estimated $50.3 billion.
DoorDash announced a definitive agreement to acquire Instacart at $65.00 per share (equity value about $17 billion), expected to close at the end of 2027 or in the first half of 2028.

ranking_method_note: Scores follow the brief's rubric exactly: five criteria scored 1-5, weighted 0.20 / 0.25 / 0.20 / 0.15 / 0.20, summed and rounded to two decimals; rank 1 is the highest weighted score. Ties are broken by beauty_category_relevance, then consumer_reach; where a tie still remained, brand_competitor_coverage, data_integration_feasibility, ecommerce_significance and finally alphabetical order were used (an addition, because the rubric is silent). estimated_market_importance reflects overall importance in the country's online retail (tier_1 = market-shaping, tier_2 = significant, tier_3 = niche or emerging), not category relevance, which is captured separately in beauty_relevance. Scoring anchors: ecommerce_significance 5 = market-shaping leader, 4 = top-tier national player, 3 = significant category or regional player, 2 = niche or emerging. consumer_reach uses Semrush estimates of US web visits for October 2026 (5 = 150 million or more, 4 = 50-150 million, 3 = 15-50 million, 2 = 3-15 million, 1 = below 3 million), adjusted where company-reported customer or order metrics justify it; web visits exclude app use. brand_competitor_coverage is an evidence-graded judgement based on how many checklist brands were confirmed on the platform's own pages or sitemaps and how deep the ranges were; platforms that refused automated access receive a neutral 3 (or 2 where positioning points to low coverage) and are marked UNVERIFIED. Checklist used for the US: Dove, Pantene, L'Oréal Paris, Garnier, Head & Shoulders, Nivea, Vaseline, Colgate, Sensodyne, Olay, Neutrogena, CeraVe, Cetaphil. data_integration_feasibility: 5 = documented public partner API plus accessible public pages, 4 = documented API with gated scope, 3 = no API but public pages or sitemaps accessible, 2 = no API and bot-protected pages. The formula rewards reach and data access, so beauty specialists and drugstores rank below general retailers even where their category relevance is equal or higher; reservations are recorded in each priority_rationale.
